acceptanceCriteria: Decision recorded: retention bound (or explicit indefinite keep with rationale) for LOST/unfinished detach records, with a requirement ID.
If a bound is chosen, a focused test shows LOST records past the bound are pruned and evidence is retained as specified.
body: Found by lane V1-1547 review repair (PR beamfall/corvint#1015, head 4a2f5e1a7) on 2026-10-17. CAL-V0-325/329 retention removes only expired finished records; LOST and unfinished detach records are kept indefinitely, so their count is unbounded over time. Also: Go runtime crash output bypasses the 64 KiB child.log cap (bounded per run by rotation). Open question: should LOST/unfinished records expire after a bound, and with what evidence retained?
title: Detached claim records that end LOST or unfinished are never pruned
